summary: Implemented U10: repair_cycles now withdraws inferred precedence edges (banked as affinity already, never declared ones) on a group-DAG cycle before falling back to the existing merge+re-split, mutating graph.dependencies in place so build_group_dag's downstream check stays consistent. Added a declared-edge parameter threaded from pipeline.py's mapper depends_on pairs, with None defaulting to pre-U10 merge-only behavior for backward compatibility. Trace RepairEntry/record_repair gained action and withdrawn_edges fields. Added new tests covering both required fixtures, determinism, and affinity banking; full existing partition/grouping/trace/pipeline suites pass, and the 5 failures seen in the full test run are pre-existing environment issues (tmp cross-device link, permission errors) in unrelated test_cli.py/test_finish.py modules untouched by this change.

verification_results.notes: test_cycle_closed_only_by_an_inferred_edge_withdraws_instead_of_merging: group count unchanged, withdrawal recorded in trace repairs with action=withdraw and edge named
test_cycle_of_solely_declared_edges_still_merges_and_never_withdraws: merge+re-split path taken, declared edges never withdrawn
test_withdrawal_repair_is_deterministic_across_runs plus assertion that withdrawn edge's weight remains in graph.affinity untouched (already banked at build time)
